svg.title: Corrected diagram: all cost lines rise with task size
svg.desc: A chart with task size on the x-axis and total cost on the y-axis. All three lines rise as task size increases: local cost rises steeply from near zero, today's offload cost starts at a moderate overhead and rises gently, and decades-ago offload cost starts at a very high overhead and also rises gently. The local line crosses today's offload line at a moderate task size and crosses the decades-ago offload line only at a much larger task size, showing that a smaller task now clears the bar for offloading than it used to.
